outcome: major sequel (auditory prosthesis, blindness, cerebral palsy, developmental quotient below 80)
cohort: Newborns born at less than 32 weeks gestational age or with a birth weight less than 1,500 g.
finding: Male gender and severe intraperiventricular hemorrhage (IPVH) were associated with a higher risk of neurodevelopmental sequels at 2 years of age.
